name: github-workflow
description: Community plugin for GitHub-based development workflows. Say 'start the next story' and the plugin picks an issue from your board, plans the architecture, builds it, runs tests, opens a PR, has that PR reviewed independently by agents in a fresh context, and applies the fixes the review asks for. It merges the PR too on projects that turn on auto-merge, which is one setting governing every command that can merge. Selection is structured rather than textual: the board column is the status and Priority, Effort and Ownership are org issue fields, so a run never reads a label or an issue body to decide anything. Supports sprint-based and flat backlogs. Bundles skills, commands and agents with least-privilege tool access, plus a setup wizard that auto-detects your project configuration and a preflight check that repairs what it safely can.
